declarations.name: ChessViewElement
declarations.description: A chessboard view of a PGN game. The game is the element's text content, so the markup is the notation and nothing else.
declarations.summary: A 2D chessboard view of a PGN game, with move navigation and highlighted notation.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Which side is at the bottom of the board.

attributes.name: game
attributes.description: Which game of a multi-game database to show, counting from 0.

attributes.name: ply
attributes.description: Which move to open at. 0 is the starting position.

attributes.name: theme
attributes.description: 'auto' follows prefers-color-scheme; 'dark' forces the dark palette.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: Show the notation itself: 'view' read-only, 'edit' to type into, re-parsing as you go.

attributes.name: commentary
attributes.description: Where the annotator's prose goes: 'inline' among the moves, 'panel' in a box of its own, or 'hidden'.

attributes.name: controls
attributes.description: Hide the navigation button bar with 'hidden'. Keyboard navigation still works.

attributes.name: notation
attributes.description: Hide the whole side panel with 'hidden', leaving just the board.

attributes.name: coordinates
attributes.description: Hide the file and rank labels around the board with 'hidden'.

members.name: move
members.description: The move currently shown, or undefined at the starting position.

members.name: ply
members.description: How far into the current line the view is; 0 is the start.

members.name: goto
members.description: Show the nth move of the current line. 0 is the starting position.

members.name: source
members.description: The notation being shown: the text content, or what the editor holds once it has been used. Settable.

members.name: load
members.description: Re-read the source and rebuild. Called automatically on change.

events.name: chess-move
events.description: Fired on every navigation, and bubbles. `detail` is `{ move, ply }`.

events.name: chess-source
events.description: Fired when the source pane is edited, and bubbles. `detail` is `{ source, ok, error }`.

cssParts.name: notation
cssParts.description: The side panel: tags, moves and status.

cssParts.name: commentary
cssParts.description: The commentary box, in panel mode.

cssParts.name: status
cssParts.description: The status line: errors, and why a line stopped.

cssParts.name: editor
cssParts.description: The textarea inside the source pane.

cssProperties.name: --glyphs
cssProperties.description: Font stack for the chess piece glyphs.

cssProperties.name: --board-from
cssProperties.description: Origin square of the move just played.

cssProperties.name: --board-to
cssProperties.description: Destination square of the move just played.

cssProperties.name: --board-check
cssProperties.description: Square of a king in check.
